title: Pass Fake and Attack
description: Ball handlers practise a convincing pass fake to freeze a defender's hands before attacking the rim off the dribble.

content.objective: Sell a pass fake convincingly enough to open a driving lane.
content.setup: A ball handler faces a defender one-on-one at the top of the key.
instructions: Step and look as if making a real pass to an imaginary teammate on the wing.
As the defender reacts, explode past them on the dribble toward the rim.
Finish with a layup, keeping the ball high and away from recovering defenders.
Reset and repeat with the fake going to the opposite side.
coachingPoints: Move the ball and the eyes together on the fake.
Attack immediately once the defender bites — don't hesitate.
Keep the fake believable; a lazy fake won't move anyone.
commonMistakes: Faking with the eyes but not the ball, or vice versa.
Waiting too long after the fake before attacking.
Catching flat-footed instead of stepping to meet the ball.
content.safety: Defender reacts to the fake but doesn't lunge aggressively at the ball.
